description.value:
Cast as the Rite

Frequency once per day

Cost 2 Zeal

Once per day, cast a Rite your patron normally forbids — enormous effect, enormous risk.

Cast any Rite from a patron other than your own, of a rank you can cast, without knowing it. The Rite is automatically heightened to your highest spell rank. When it resolves, roll on the Backlash Table twice and apply both results; neither may be rerolled, avoided, or shifted by any effect, including Backlash Control and Zealotry Mastery. Your patron does not punish you for this. It simply watches, and adds it to the account.

cinderfall.incomplete: Casts another patron's Rite unheightened knowledge heightened to max, then rolls the homebrew Backlash Table twice with no mitigation allowed. This is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem (the Backlash Table) with zero Foundry schema footprint -- no RollTable-manipulation rule element exists anywhere in pf2e-source's 40 rule-element type files to hook a homebrew random table to. Also carries a Zeal cost, separately unbuildable (see P-ZEAL) but not the deciding factor here.
